Group Transition — Downgrade · Reactivate · Cancel & Delete
Downgrade: Active Group → Listing — verifies modal flow, success toast, and paused billing state

Cancel & Delete: Active Group → Deleted — verifies outer modal, reason flow, and success toast
Multi-Group — Transitions (Downgrade · Reactivate · Cancel & Delete · Cancel Subscription)
Downgrade: one group Active → Listing — verifies group-scoped menu, modal, and success toast
Reactivate: same group Listing → Active — via My Groups → group leader-space → Upgrade to Active Group
Cancel & Delete: same group → permanently deleted — verifies per-group menu, reason flow, and removal
Cancel Subscription: cancel the whole Multi-Group plan — all remaining groups → Listing
